# Pulsa

> Pulsa is a cardio-coaching web app (portfolio project by Antiqa, not medical advice). It reads heart-rate data from a watch or chest strap, turns it into zones, recovery and trends, adapts the training plan every day and connects members with certified cardio coaches.

## Pages

- [Home](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/): how Pulsa works (reads every beat, adapts daily, real coaches)
- [Programs](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/programs): heart-rate based programs such as Zone 2 base, HIIT intervals, recovery, half marathon prep, cycling threshold and HRV, each with target zones
- [Coaches](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/coaches): cardio coaches and their specialities
- [Pricing](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/pricing): Starter (free), Pulse (daily adaptive plan), Coach+ (personal cardio coach), plus FAQ
- [Contact](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/contact): questions about programs, coaching or an account
- [Create account](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/register) and [Log in](https://my-fitness-app-tau-drab.vercel.app/login)

The member dashboard (/dashboard, /users, /cards, /staff) needs a login and is not meant for indexing.
